purpose: 20 scraped cards normalised by hand into StrategySpec, staged for a first backtest run. Not library records: nothing here has been measured, and none of it may be added to strategies/library until a walk-forward has graded it.

excluded.USDJPY: quote currency is JPY and RunInputs defaults to SameCurrencyConverter; every signal would be refused as fx_rate_unavailable

strategies.card_says: Only trade with the 100 EMA high/low channel; wait for price to touch or break the far Bollinger band (20 periods at 2.3 σ, MA 10) while staying on the trend side of the channel; enter when price retraces back into the band or at the next bar's open; stop at the previous swing; target 2:1.
analyst_substitutions: The card's two-step (touch, then retrace back in) is written as one trigger: the previous bar's low at or below the band, and this bar's close crossing back above it. Written as a level test alone it held for runs of consecutive bars and opened 7 805 setups instead of 1 239 — a condition, not the event the card describes.
Invalidation is the trigger bar's low; the previous swing regularly sat above price on a band touch and was being refused as wrong-sided.
strategies.exit_rationale: conservative_2r — the card recommends 2:1 outright.
strategies.source_title: Bollinger Band Trading in Trend Trading System

strategies.card_says: Price closes beyond both Kumo, which must agree, and beyond the bank levels; SMA 20 and 50 on the chart; stop beyond the previous swing; ratio 1:2 to 1:2.5.
analyst_substitutions: 'Both Kumo agree' is close beyond senkou_a *and* senkou_b, with senkou_a the crossing operand. The repo's Ichimoku publishes the leading spans at the bar they are plotted at, computed from data displacement bars earlier, so this is causal.
Tenkan/kijun alignment carries the quality modifier — the card's 'in agreement'.
dropped_from_card: Bank levels and delta arrows — visual.
The second Ichimoku (1,1,25) — a repainted fast cloud with no counterpart.
strategies.exit_rationale: conservative_2r — the card's 1:2.
strategies.source_title: 205-ichimochu-aggressive-breakout

strategies.card_says: Price closes beyond the 5 SMMA of the high (low for shorts); MACD(8,21,8) in buy mode; stochastic recently out of oversold and heading up; RSI(13) above its own Bollinger midline and above 50. Stop at the last obvious swing or 55–80 pips; target 50–70 pips.
analyst_substitutions: SMMA(5) is EMA(9) by definition (SMMA(n) = EMA(2n−1)); written as ema(period=9, source=high/low), which the indicator registry supports directly.
'RSI above the middle Bollinger band drawn on RSI' is an indicator on an indicator; the card states the same requirement a second time as 'RSI above 50', which is what is kept.
'MACD in buy mode' read as histogram above zero.
strategies.exit_rationale: structure_trail — the card's exit is price crossing the opposite side of its own MA channel, i.e. a structure-following stop.
strategies.source_title: Breakout H1 Method  Trading System

strategies.card_says: Trend from the SMMA channel against the middle Bollinger band; wait for price at a support/resistance area; take divergence between price and CCI(21); require volume forming significantly higher peaks; stop beyond the recent swing; trail with the channel.
analyst_substitutions: Divergence between price and an oscillator is not expressible (it needs a comparison of two slopes over a variable window). Replaced by CCI(21) crossing back out of ±100 — the momentum turn the divergence is a leading version of.
'High volume, significantly higher peaks' is rvol(20) > 1.5, with > 2.5 as the quality modifier. This is the real tick volume of the new vendor tape, not the constant the Forexite tape carried.
dropped_from_card: Drawn support/resistance areas; the 30m/4H split (cross-timeframe is unsupported — both legs run on H4).
strategies.exit_rationale: structure_trail — the card trails with its channel.

strategies.card_says: A doji after an extended move; sell once a new closing low is made below the doji's low (mirrored for the high-close doji); stop beyond the doji's extreme; MACD as a filter; 25 EMA high/low channel on the chart.
analyst_substitutions: The doji is the trigger and the closing break is a confirmation inside a 2-bar window — pattern_is has no shift, so 'a doji on the previous bar' cannot be written as one leaf.
The invalidation is the *signal* bar's extreme, not the doji's: Invalidation reads the bar the signal fires on. On the bar after the doji these differ.
dropped_from_card: 'Stop-close-only' — the exit library has no close-only stop.
strategies.exit_rationale: structure_trail — the card exits on the first bar that makes a higher closing high, which is a structure-following exit.
strategies.source_title: Low close doji and High close doji

strategies.card_says: Long on the N-day high, short on the N-day low; hard stop 2×ATR; exit on the opposite shorter-period channel; MACD above zero permits longs, below zero permits shorts.
analyst_substitutions: The channel is read with shift=1. A Donchian channel contains the bar being tested, so close cross_above upper can never fire without it — the exact case CLAUDE.md records FeatureRef.shift for.
Entry breakout 20 bars, exit breakout 10 bars — the card leaves N to the user; these are the Turtle defaults it is quoting.
dropped_from_card: Entry/exit offsets in ATR — a tunable the card itself says may be zero.
strategies.exit_rationale: structure_trail — the card's exit *is* a trailing channel.

strategies.card_says: EMA5 crosses SMA15 and MACD lines cross, in either order, no more than 5 candles apart; never open within 25 pips of the 100/200 SMA; initial stop 50 pips; trail after 50 pips.
analyst_substitutions: The 5-candle window is the schema's confirmation_window_bars = 6 (the trigger bar counts as one). Only the MA-cross-first ordering is expressible; a spec cannot make either of two events the trigger.
dropped_from_card: 'Never open within 25 pips of the 100/200 SMA' — this is |close − sma| < 0.0025, arithmetic over two operands, which CLAUDE.md already names as the missing DerivedOperand. This is the second such case; the first was the close-in-range-of-bar rule.
strategies.exit_rationale: breakeven_runner — the card's 'trail after 50 pips in profit'.

strategies.card_says: Close beyond EMA60 with CCI(14) past ±100; enter at market with two lots; take one off at +200 pips, move the rest to breakeven, then trail.
analyst_substitutions: The buy rule as printed reads 'CCI value is lower than +100', which contradicts its own mirror sell rule and the worked example. Read as a typo for 'higher than +100'.

'Stop just beyond EMA60 or −200 pips, whichever is less risky' cannot be written: the Risk Engine takes the *farthest* of its stop candidates, so declaring FIXED_PIPS(200) would pin every stop at 200 pips. EMA60 stays as the invalidation, ATR(14,1.5) is the stop reference.
dropped_from_card: Two-lot manual scale-out — the exit library's swing_partial_ladder is the same shape.
strategies.exit_rationale: swing_partial_ladder — partial at 1R, breakeven, then a structure trail is the closest preset to 'one lot off, breakeven the rest, trail'.
strategies.source_title: Smashing Forex System 2 Trading System

strategies.card_says: Stochastic (10,3,3) crossing up out of 40 with HMA(14) turning; stop on the previous swing; target 1:1; three-step martingale money management.
analyst_substitutions: 'HMA black / white colour' is the HMA's slope; written as rising/falling over one bar.
'Crosses I-G-CCI 2' — a custom indicator with no counterpart; the crossing of the 40/60 band is the part of the rule the card also states in words.

Invalidation is the trigger bar's own low/high rather than the previous swing: on a counter-trend entry the last *confirmed* swing is regularly on the wrong side of price, and 15% of signals were being dropped as wrong_sided_invalidation. The structural stop still comes from STRUCTURE(5) in stop_reference.
dropped_from_card: Martingale sizing — sizing is the Risk Engine's, and a spec cannot ask for it.
strategies.exit_rationale: rr_1r — the card's 'fast profit predetermined with ratio stop loss 1:1'.

strategies.card_says: Inside bar with ADX ≥ 25 and DI+ above DI− for longs; buy stop 5 pips above the preceding candle's high; stop 5 pips beyond the inside bar; target 1:1.5 or better.
analyst_substitutions: The stop order's offset is measured from the reference price (the close of the inside bar), not from the preceding candle's high — EntryOrderSpec has no 'offset from a named level' form. 5 pips (0.0005) is kept as the offset; it is a slightly different level.
strategies.exit_rationale: rr_1_5r — the card's 'Target risk to reward 1/1.5 or better'; 1.5R is the ratio it names, and 'or better' is a licence, not a second preset.
strategies.source_title: Inside Bar with ADX Forex Trading  System

strategies.card_says: RSI(8) crosses its own moving average; SMA(28) on the chart; stop = 75% of ATR(20); enter at the open of the next candle; no exit rule, ride it with a moving stop.
analyst_substitutions: RSI crossing *its own* moving average is an indicator computed on an indicator, which no FeatureRef can express. Replaced by RSI(8) cross of the 50 midline — the same momentum flip the card's cross is a smoothed reading of.
SMA(28) is on the card's chart but no rule uses it; promoted to the trend gate (close above/below it), which is what a trader would do with it.
strategies.exit_rationale: breakeven_runner — the card's exit is 'let it run with a moving stop', which is breakeven at 1R then an ATR trail.

strategies.card_says: Price closes below both the lower Bollinger band and the lower Keltner channel, then retraces and closes back above the Keltner channel; buy at the open of the next bar; initial stop at the previous swing; target the middle band.
analyst_substitutions: Invalidation is the Keltner channel itself rather than the previous swing: the trigger guarantees the close is above it, so the level is correctly sided by construction. With the swing, 3 658 of 4 352 signals were refused as wrong-sided — the failure mode is systematic on a falling-knife entry, not incidental.
strategies.exit_rationale: rr_1r — the card's 'ratio minimum 1:1 stop loss'; the middle band it also names is roughly that distance from a band-edge entry.

strategies.card_says: Establish the range of an initial session period (the example uses 120 minutes around the London open); go long on a close above the range high, short below the low; the setup is closed for the rest of the session once taken; protective stop at the opposite end of the range.
analyst_substitutions: The range is donchian(8) shifted one bar — a rolling two hours of M15 rather than a clock-anchored session box. A range anchored to a wall-clock time is not expressible; this is the closest rolling equivalent and it is not the same rule.

The session restriction is a session_is leaf inside the trigger, not a SessionFilter. StrategySpec.filters are read by nothing that gates a signal (see the report); a session_is condition is compiled and enforced. Measured: the leaf halves the signal count, 11 684 → 5 739 on EURUSD.
rvol(20) > 1.2 as the 'valid breakout' test the card gestures at.
dropped_from_card: 'One trade per session' — max_concurrent_positions=1 plus a cooldown is the nearest the risk profile can say.
strategies.exit_rationale: session_close — the card is explicit that the setup dies with the session.
strategies.source_title: Breakout with Market Structure Breaker  . TradingView Strategy

strategies.card_says: Money Flow Index(8) in oversold while price touches or breaks the lower Bollinger(22, 2.0); wait for a bullish candle; stop at the previous swing or on the band; target the mid band or 1:1; profit target 8 pips on EUR/USD.
analyst_substitutions: 'Wait for a bullish candle' is a confirmation leaf, close above open, inside a 3-bar window.
Invalidation is the signal bar's own low — the previous swing was refusing 3 312 of 4 340 signals as wrong-sided, for the same reason as the Keltner card.
dropped_from_card: The direction-arrow entry timing, QQE-MACD, BullsEye Forecast and Half Trend — all custom indicators with no counterpart.
Oscar Grind / Kelly / D'Alembert money management — sizing is not a spec's to name.

strategies.card_says: Price crosses above the 50 EMA of the high; Williams %R crosses above −20; stochastic above its signal line and above 60; stop a few pips below the recent swing low; target twice the stop.
analyst_substitutions: The card's sell rule says '%R crosses above the −80 level' where its own logic requires below. Read as crossing down through −80.

exit_library_note: The risk/reward ladder rr_1r..rr_10r was added to exit/library.json for this batch: nine specs had been given conservative_2r because the library carried no fixed target below 2R, which substituted a different strategy for the one the card described.
